Start with a free 10-minute consultation, a focused consultation, or the standard 53-minute diagnostic evaluation.

How we can help

Care begins with understanding what matters now.

Care is collaborative and tailored to the person, relationship, or family. Sessions can combine thoughtful reflection with practical tools that support meaningful change outside the therapy room.

In-person appointments are available in Woodinville. Secure telehealth may be available to eligible clients physically located in Washington, subject to clinical fit, clinician availability, and applicable requirements.

How to begin

Know your path into care.

Individual clients may go directly to a diagnostic evaluation (90791). The free 10-minute phone consultation and paid 30-minute individual consultation are optional.

Optional · free

10-minute phone consultation

A brief introduction available to all clients, not a therapy session or diagnostic evaluation. Occasionally arranged by telehealth; if technology does not work immediately, it becomes a phone call. Calls may display Marriage.Family.Therapy or a hidden number.

Schedule a free consultation →

Optional · private pay

30-minute individual consultation

More time to discuss fit, questions, and the care process. This paid consultation is optional and is separate from the diagnostic evaluation.

Schedule a 30-minute individual consultation →

First clinical appointment

Diagnostic evaluation (90791)

Start directly with the evaluation. Your clinician gathers information about your concerns, history, and goals to develop a measurable treatment plan using an evidence-based approach suited to your needs.

Request a diagnostic evaluation →

Insurance coverage depends on clinical appropriateness, clinician participation, and plan benefits. Read the complete scheduling guide.

Schedule the right appointment

Existing clients: schedule an appointmentSchedule a 30-minute couples consultation

Couples: 30-minute consultation → one evaluation for each partner → initial 53-minute couples session. A 10-minute call is optional and does not replace these steps.
